text_block_list.text: One day, Narita Brian was holding her head in her hands in the library...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Useless, I don't get this at all...
What the hell am I supposed to come up with from a course layout diagram?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... How does Sis not get a headache
from doing nothing but reading books all day...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What was that about my head...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You look to be in a particularly foul mood today.
Is something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing. Just leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Out with it. Looking at you, isn't this
something where you need my assistance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What are you,
a mind reader or something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're simply an open book. You always have been.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Student council duties. They dumped planning
a race for the Fan Appreciation Festival on me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why you were
studying that course layout diagram...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Enough already. That's all there is to it.
It's not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't act so tough.
"I'm in trouble" is written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How about this, then?
Truth is, I have an intractable problem of my own right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want you to solve it for me.
If we solve each other's problems, that should be fair, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Each other's, huh...
Well... I suppose that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Now that that's settled, things move fast!
Together as sisters, let's make this the ultimate race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're way too fired up over this...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it's not every day you come asking
me for help! Of course I'm fired up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
This is why I hate relying on you, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, we can figure out the race later...
What's your problem anyway?
If you're asking me for help, it must be something serious.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed.
In fact, it's a problem only you can solve.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, if you apply yourself seriously, it's something
that could easily be resolved today. Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Will you just tell me what I have to do already?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Very well. You see, I have a younger sister who hates vegetables.
I want to get her to eat her vegetables by any means necessary.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A problem you can resolve quite easily, wouldn't you say?
Right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What—?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, our promise has already been made.
Revoking it is impossible. Now then, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You set me up, Sis!!
